info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — Media, Layouts & Notifications
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — Media, Layouts & Notifications.** Video processing, custom layouts and the layout gallery, activity feeds and user notifications.

get.summary: List all custom layouts for the organization

200.description: Custom layouts joined with their CE `content_type_layouts` row, most recently updated first — so each item also carries the CE name, version and default/active flags.

post.summary: Create a new custom layout

201.description: The created layout. The CE `content_type_layouts` row and this row are written in one transaction, and the initial definition is recorded as version history entry 1.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get custom layout by ID

200.description: The custom layout row, including its draft and version history.
The layout after the update — re-read, so `updated_at` is the new precondition.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Publish the current draft layout

201.description: The layout after publishing: the draft is cleared, `published_at` refreshed and a new patch version prepended to `version_history`.

get.summary: Get version history for a custom layout

200.description: Published versions, newest first, capped at 50 entries; empty array for a layout that was never published.

post.summary: Restore a previous version as draft

201.description: The layout with the restored definition as its draft — the live CE definition is untouched until the draft is published.

post.summary: Duplicate a custom layout

201.description: The new copy — a fresh layout id (`<original>--copy-<timestamp>`), version 1.0.0 and "(Copy)"-suffixed names.

post.summary: Import a layout from a JSON definition

201.description: The imported layout. `layout_id` and `content_type_id` are taken from the definition unless overridden in the request.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Export a layout definition as JSON

200.description: The published layout/v1 definition, sanitized: org-specific asset URLs and ids are stripped because an export leaves its tenant (IMP-PRO-LAYOUT-07). `{}` when the CE row carries no definition.

post.summary: Configure Git repository for layout sync (token stored encrypted)

201.description: The stored configuration with a masked token hint, plus a data-sovereignty warning when the remote is a known non-EU forge.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get Git sync status

200.description: Current configuration, last sync marker and layout count. `configured: false` with null fields when Git was never set up.

post.summary: Pull layout definitions from Git into drafts

201.description: Sync tally plus the per-file outcome of every `*.layout.json` found, so a partial pull is legible. Incoming definitions land as drafts, never as published layouts.

post.summary: Push layout exports to the configured Git repository

201.description: Number of layouts written and the resulting commit; `upToDate: true` with a null commit hash when the export already matched the repository.

get.summary: Published gallery entries (cross-org) + own submissions

200.description: Most-installed first. Cross-org entries never expose source-org fields or the raw definition; `status`/`reviewNote` appear only on the caller’s own submissions.

post.summary: Submit one of the org’s layouts to the gallery (sanitized snapshot)

201.description: The new submission plus the JSON paths the sanitizer stripped, so the submitter can see what was removed before review.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Review a submission (instance super-admin only)

200.description: The entry id and the state it moved to.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Install a published gallery layout as a fresh local copy

201.description: UUID of the local layout created in the caller’s organization. Only an organization’s first install bumps the entry’s download counter.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Rate a published gallery layout (one rating per org, anonymous)

200.description: Aggregates recomputed from the rating rows after the vote (an organization’s repeat vote replaces its previous one).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List video processing jobs (optionally filtered)

200.description: Jobs of the organization, newest first, capped at 100 rows.

post.summary: Queue a video processing job for an asset

201.description: The queued job in status `pending`. `transcode_profile` holds the resolved profile — or a `ladder` array when several profile ids were passed.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a video processing job by ID

200.description: The job row; 404 when unknown.

post.summary: Retry a failed video processing job

201.description: The job reset to `pending` with `attempts` incremented and the previous error cleared. Only failed jobs within their attempt ceiling can be retried.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or processing video job

201.description: The job after the cancel request: a pending job is `cancelled` immediately, a processing one becomes `cancelling` until the worker honours the flag.

get.summary: Video job statistics for the organization

200.description: Job counts per state plus the mean processing time of completed jobs.

get.summary: List the active renditions of a video asset

200.description: Active renditions only, widest first — superseded outputs are excluded because their storage objects are being purged.

get.summary: Aggregated video info for an asset (metadata, keys, renditions, captions)

200.description: Each field is the latest non-null value across the asset’s completed jobs (IMP-PRO-MEDIA-05), plus the rendition registry and ready caption tracks. All fields null/empty for an asset that was never processed.

get.summary: List transcode profiles of the organization

200.description: All profiles, the default one first, then alphabetically by name.

post.summary: Create a transcode profile

201.description: The created profile as stored. Creating it as default unsets the organization’s previous default.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a transcode profile by ID

200.description: The profile row; 404 when unknown.
The profile after the update (re-read from the database).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List the caption tracks of a video asset

200.description: Every track of the asset regardless of status, the default one first then by locale.

post.summary: Upload a WebVTT caption track for a video asset

201.description: The stored track (`source: uploaded`, `status: ready`). Re-uploading a locale replaces the existing track and purges the previous object; invalid WebVTT is rejected with 400.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List notifications for the current user

200.description: The user’s inbox, newest first — archived and deferred (pending-digest) rows excluded. The envelope additionally carries `total`, the unpaged match count.

post.summary: Create a notification (system alerts, manual sends)

201.description: The created row. Created directly, so recipient preferences (DND, mutes, digest) are not applied.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get unread count for the current user

200.description: Badge count: unread, non-archived, non-deferred notifications.

get.summary: Get a single notification by ID

200.description: The notification, or `data: null` when no row of this organization matches.
Acknowledgement; deleting an unknown id also reports success.

post.summary: Mark a notification as read

200.description: Acknowledgement; already-read notifications also report success.

post.summary: Mark all notifications as read

200.description: How many previously-unread notifications were marked read.

post.summary: Archive a notification

200.description: Acknowledgement; the row is hidden from the inbox listing afterwards.

delete.summary: Delete all read notifications of the current user

200.description: How many read notifications were deleted.

get.summary: Get notification preferences for the current user

200.description: The stored preferences, or `data: null` when the user never saved any (service defaults then apply).

put.summary: Update notification preferences for the current user

200.description: The preferences after the upsert (created on first call).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List all notification channels for the organization

200.description: Every channel of the organization, newest first.

get.summary: Get a single notification channel by ID

200.description: The channel, or `data: null` when no channel of this organization matches.
The channel after the update, or `data: null` when the id is unknown.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: `success: false` when no channel of this organization matched the id.

post.summary: Create a new notification channel

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Test a notification channel by sending a test message

200.description: Delivery outcome. A failed test is reported in the body (with `error`), not as an HTTP error.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get notification statistics for the organization

200.description: Counts by state and type, channel health totals and rolling activity.

post.summary: Run housekeeping — delete notifications older than `days`

200.description: How many rows the retention sweep removed.

get.summary: Team activity feed (newest first, cursor-paginated)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: ISO created_at cursor for the next page

200.description: One page of the org-scoped feed, newest first (max 100). The envelope additionally carries `cursor` — the `created_at` of the last item, to pass as `before` for the next page; null when the page is empty.

repoUrl.description: Git repository URL (https://, ssh:// or git@host:path)

path.description: Path within the repo for layout files

contentTypeId.description: Content type ID this layout is for

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

actor_id.description: User that acted; null for system-generated entries (scheduler, release runner)

resource.description: Kind of object the activity refers to

meta.description: Small human context of the source event — e.g. `contentTypeId`/`status` for content, `fromState`/`toState`/`workflowId` for transitions, `action`/`error` for failed schedules. Varies per verb.

created_at.description: When it happened — also the pagination cursor (`before`)

layout_id.description: Layout identifier, unique per (organization, content type)

draft_definition.description: Unpublished working copy of the layout/v1 definition; null when the draft was published or never started. Drafts may omit `layout_id`/`content_type`/`version`, so the shape is open-ended.

published_at.description: When the layout was last published into CE’s `content_type_layouts`

version_history.description: Published versions, newest first, capped at 50 entries

gallery_status.description: Gallery submission state of this layout; null when never submitted

gallery_id.description: Gallery entry id this layout was submitted as; null when never submitted

download_count.description: Installs of this layout from the gallery

updated_at.description: Last modification. Echo it as `expectedUpdatedAt` on PUT to get optimistic-concurrency protection (IMP-PRO-LAYOUT-01).

layout_id.description: Layout identifier, unique per (organization, content type)

draft_definition.description: Unpublished working copy of the layout/v1 definition; null when the draft was published or never started. Drafts may omit `layout_id`/`content_type`/`version`, so the shape is open-ended.

published_at.description: When the layout was last published into CE’s `content_type_layouts`

version_history.description: Published versions, newest first, capped at 50 entries

gallery_status.description: Gallery submission state of this layout; null when never submitted

gallery_id.description: Gallery entry id this layout was submitted as; null when never submitted

download_count.description: Installs of this layout from the gallery

updated_at.description: Last modification. Echo it as `expectedUpdatedAt` on PUT to get optimistic-concurrency protection (IMP-PRO-LAYOUT-01).

layout_name.description: Localized name of the joined CE layout row, keyed by locale

ce_version.description: Semver version of the published CE layout row

is_default.description: Whether this is the default layout of its content type

is_active.description: Whether the CE layout row is active (offered for rendering)

name.description: Localized layout name, keyed by locale

settings.description: Layout-level settings (max width, colour scheme, spacing, …)

breakpoints.description: Breakpoint definitions keyed by name, each `{ min_width?, max_width? }`

responsive_overrides.description: Per-breakpoint overrides of region styles, keyed by breakpoint

contentTypeId.description: Portable content type id the layout targets

downloadCount.description: How many organizations installed this entry

averageRating.description: Mean rating rounded to one decimal; null when never rated

ratingCount.description: Number of organizations that rated the entry

mine.description: True when the calling organization submitted this entry

status.description: Review state — returned only for the caller’s own submissions (review state is the submitter’s business only)

reviewNote.description: Reviewer note — returned only for the caller’s own submissions

layoutId.description: UUID of the freshly created local custom layout in the caller’s organization

installed.description: Always true — a failed install is an HTTP error

averageRating.description: Mean rating after the vote, rounded to one decimal

ratingCount.description: Number of organizations that have rated the entry

id.description: Gallery entry UUID created by the submission

status.description: State of the fresh entry — awaiting instance-super-admin review

strippedPaths.description: JSON paths of org-specific values (asset URLs/ids) the sanitizer stripped before storing the snapshot

path.description: Sub-path within the repository holding the layout files; null for the root

tokenHint.description: Masked hint of the vault-stored access token (the token itself is never returned); null when no token is stored

sovereigntyWarning.description: Data-sovereignty advisory when the remote is a known non-EU-hosted forge; null otherwise

commitHash.description: Commit hash created by the push; null when nothing changed

upToDate.description: True when the export matched the repository and no commit was made

configured.description: Whether this organization has a Git config row

repoUrl.description: Configured Git remote; null when unconfigured

tokenHint.description: Masked hint of the vault-stored access token; null when no token is stored

lastSync.description: When a sync or push last succeeded

commitHash.description: Commit hash of the last successful sync/push

layoutCount.description: Custom layouts this organization currently has

path.description: Path of the file inside the repository (relative to the configured sub-path)

status.description: Per-file outcome. `created` imported a new layout, `updated` wrote a new draft on an existing one, `skipped` was not a usable layout file, `failed` could not be imported.

layoutId.description: Layout id read from the file, when it had one

reason.description: Why the file was skipped or failed

commitHash.description: Commit hash the repository was read at

updated.description: Existing layouts that received a new draft

skipped.description: Files that were not usable layout files

files.description: Every file the sync looked at, so a partial pull stays legible

id.description: Region id, unique within the layout

field_bindings.description: Content fields bound into this region, keyed by binding name

label.description: Localized region label, keyed by locale

style.description: Presentation style of the region (open-ended style bag)

condition.description: Visibility condition — `{ field, operator, value? }` evaluated against the content at render time

children.description: Nested regions; absent for leaf regions (the structure is recursive)

items.description: Recursive — same shape as `ProLayoutRegionDto`. Inlined as a free-form object because a self-referencing schema cannot be dereferenced into a finite document.

version.description: Semver version this entry was published as

definition.description: The full layout definition as published in this version (a layout/v1 document; drafts may be partial). Kept verbatim so it can be restored.

success.description: Always true — the operation is idempotent and reports success even when nothing matched (e.g. an already-read notification)

count.description: Number of notification rows the operation changed

enabled.description: Disabled channels are skipped by every dispatch

config.description: Connection settings as stored; carries at least `webhookUrl` (or `url`). The URL is SSRF-validated on write and again at every send.

events.description: Event types that trigger this channel; an empty array means "every event"

data_transfer_ack.description: Explicit GDPR acknowledgement that notification content leaves the EU. Required (and re-checked at send time) for slack/teams/discord channels (IMP-PRO-NOTIF-02).

last_error.description: Message of the last failed delivery

consecutive_failures.description: Failures since the last success (channel-health telemetry)

success.description: Whether the test message was accepted by the target

error.description: Why the test failed — a transport error, a missing channel, or a missing EU transfer acknowledgement

data.description: Free-form payload of the emitting event — typically `contentId`, `contentTypeId` and an `_i18n` block (`{ key, params }`) the client uses to render a localized message. Shape varies per notification type.

read_at.description: When the recipient read it; null while unread

archived_at.description: When it was archived; archived rows are excluded from the inbox listing

channels_sent.description: Ids of the external channels this notification was delivered to

pending_digest.description: True while the row is deferred (IMP-PRO-NOTIF-05): created during a DND window or for a digest-frequency user, hidden from inbox and unread count until the digest job releases it.

deleted.description: Notifications deleted because they were older than the retention window

digest_frequency.description: Delivery cadence. Anything but `realtime`/`never` defers rows into a digest batch (IMP-PRO-NOTIF-05).

dnd_start.description: Start of the do-not-disturb window (PostgreSQL TIME), null when unset

dnd_end.description: End of the do-not-disturb window (PostgreSQL TIME); a value before `dnd_start` wraps past midnight

type_overrides.description: Per-notification-type overrides keyed by notification type, each `{ inApp?: boolean, email?: boolean }`. `inApp: false` suppresses the in-app row entirely.

muted_content_ids.description: Content ids the user muted — notifications referencing them are dropped

muted_content_types.description: Content type ids the user muted

last_digest_at.description: When this user’s digest was last flushed

last24h.description: Notifications created in the last 24 hours

last7d.description: Notifications created in the last 7 days

last30d.description: Notifications created in the last 30 days

totalNotifications.description: All notification rows of the organization

byType.description: Notification count per notification type, busiest first

count.description: Unread, non-archived, non-deferred notifications of the current user

video_bitrate.description: Target video bitrate, always of the form `NNNNk` — the worker interpolates it into ffmpeg arguments, so the format is constrained at rest (IMP-PRO-MEDIA-03)

audio_bitrate.description: Target audio bitrate, same `NNNNk` constraint as `video_bitrate`

max_file_size.description: Soft cap for the output size in bytes

is_default.description: Whether this is the organization’s default profile

asset_id.description: Video asset the track belongs to

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag; one track per (asset, locale)

storage_key.description: Storage key of the stored WebVTT document

source.description: Where the track came from: an operator upload, or a local transcription engine (never a non-EU SaaS by default)

status.description: Only `ready` tracks are offered to players

is_default.description: Whether players should preselect this track

cue_count.description: Number of cues parsed from the WebVTT

size_bytes.description: Size of the WebVTT document in bytes

error_message.description: Why an auto-transcription failed; null otherwise

created_by.description: User that uploaded the track; null for machine-generated tracks

storage_key.description: Storage key of the WebVTT document

status.description: Always `ready` here — the video info only carries usable tracks

is_default.description: Whether players should preselect this track

metadata.description: Latest probed metadata across the asset’s completed jobs

thumbnailKey.description: Latest non-null thumbnail storage key across completed jobs

transcodeKey.description: Latest non-null transcode storage key across completed jobs

muxData.description: Latest external streaming payload (`assetId`, `playbackId`, `streamingUrl`, optional URL maps); null when no provider is configured. Provider-defined shape.

lastJobStatus.description: Status of the most recently created job for this asset

renditions.description: Active renditions, widest first (the asset’s quality ladder)

captions.description: Ready caption tracks, default first then by locale

created_by.description: User that queued the job; null once that user was erased (GDPR)

status.description: Lifecycle state. `cancelling` is the cooperative flag a processing job honours between stages; `cancelled` is the finalized state.

transcode_profile.description: Snapshot of the requested encoding settings: either one profile (`id`, `name`, `format`, `width`, `height`, `videoBitrate`, `audioBitrate`, `quality`, `maxFileSize`) or `{ ladder: [ …profiles ] }` for a quality ladder (IMP-PRO-MEDIA-07). Null when the job needs no profile. Open-ended by design.

video_metadata.description: Probed source metadata; filled once a metadata/full job completed

thumbnail_key.description: Storage key of the generated thumbnail

transcode_key.description: Storage key of the transcoded output (single-profile jobs)

mux_data.description: External streaming provider payload when one is configured — `assetId`, `playbackId`, `streamingUrl` and optional `mp4Urls` / `thumbnailUrls` maps. Provider-defined, so the shape is open-ended.

thumbhash.description: Base64 ThumbHash used as a blurred video placeholder

error_message.description: Failure message of the last attempt

error_details.description: Structured failure context (stderr excerpts, stage, exit code)

attempts.description: Attempts consumed so far; bounded by MEDIA_MAX_ATTEMPTS (IMP-PRO-MEDIA-04)

heartbeat_at.description: Last worker heartbeat. A processing job whose heartbeat is older than 15 minutes counts as abandoned and is requeued or deletable.

caption_locale.description: Locale a captions job transcribes into; null falls back to MEDIA_TRANSCRIBE_LOCALE

processing_time_ms.description: Wall-clock processing time of the successful attempt, in milliseconds

total.description: All video jobs of the organization

processing.description: Jobs currently claimed by a worker

avgProcessingTimeMs.description: Mean processing time of completed jobs in milliseconds; null when none completed

codec.description: Video codec as reported by ffprobe

hasAudio.description: Whether the file carries an audio stream

job_id.description: Job that produced it; null once that job was deleted

kind.description: What kind of output this is

storage_key.description: Storage key of the stored object

size_bytes.description: Size of the stored object in bytes

profile_id.description: Transcode profile that produced it; null for profile-less outputs

profile_snapshot.description: Copy of the profile settings at production time — profiles may change afterwards, so this is what the file actually encodes. Open-ended.

status.description: Only `active` renditions are delivered; a re-transcode marks the previous one `superseded` before its object is purged.

draftDefinition.description: Draft layout definition JSON (not yet published)

isDefault.description: Set (or unset) as the default layout for its content type
